276147436.description:
Natural crystal cluster specimen with clusters of pointed purple and lavender crystal terminations across the top face, consistent with amethyst quartz. Several larger milky white to clear quartz points sit among the purple crystals. The underside is a rough matrix base with tan, cream, and greenish mineral deposits, and the piece rests upright on that flat base for display. Coloring shifts from deeper purple at the tips to pale near the base. Dimensions are estimated at roughly 5 inches long by 4 inches wide by 3 inches tall. No stand, box, or paperwork is included.

Condition: Natural specimen with rough, uneven edges. Some crystal tips have small chips and dings, and there are reddish brown and greenish mineral staining areas on the matrix and along one side. Dust and loose grit are present in the recesses of the base.
